videos.title: HSMA 6 Showcase Introduction - A Look Back at HSMA 6
videos.description:
In this video, Dr Dan Chalk gives an overview of the sixth round of the HSMA programme. He also gives an insight into the plans for HSMA 7 and beyond. We wrap up by hearing from Professor Stuart Logan about what HSMA means to PenARC. 

HSMA website: https://www.hsma.co.uk
HSMA books: https://www.hsma.co.uk/books
HSMA modules: https://www.hsma.co.uk/learn

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Simulation Modelling for Tackling Backlogs in Children's Neurodiversity and NHS Talking Therapies
videos.description:
In this video, Heath McDonald (Senior Business Intelligence Developer, Lancashire & South Cumbria
NHS Foundation Trust) talks us through his HSMA projects on using simulation modelling to tackle backlogs in children's neurodiversity assessment and NHS Talking Therapies. 

This talk was part of the HSMA 6 Showcase event on Tuesday 24th June. 

HSMA Website: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Simulation Modelling of Non-Elective Flow
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Helena Robinson (Senior Analyst/Data Scientist, Countess of Chester NHS Foundation Trust) about her HSMA project on using discrete event simulation to model non-elective flow. 

Code: https://github.com/Countess-of-Chester-Hospital-NHS-FT/Non-Elective-Flow-Simulation
Tool: https://non-elective-flow-simulation-coch.streamlit.app/
Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6001_DES_modelling_non_elective_flow/index
HSMA Website: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.title: Predicting Surgical Times from Patient Note Data
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dr Jake Wilson (Urology Specialist Registrar, Great Western Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) about his project on predicting the operation times for robotic assisted laparoscopy (RALP) in prostate cancer from patient notes, using natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning (ML). 

Code: https://github.com/wilsonwilko/App
Tool: https://ralpulator.streamlit.app/
Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6047_RALPulator/index
HSMA Website: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.title: HSMA 6 Lightning Talks Session 1 - Blood Donation Capacity, GP Phone Calls, HRG Coding and More!
videos.description:
In this session, we hear about four different projects undertaken by our HSMAs. 

1. (0:30) Forecasting blood donation session capacity - Sam Plimmer, NHS Blood and Transplant - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6034_Forcasting_blood_donation_sesion_capacity/index.html

2. (4:26) Modelling GP phone calls - Sarah Blincko, NHS England - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6008_Modelling_GP_phone_calls/index.html

3. (7:53) Using classification modelling techniques to investigate changes in HRG coding over time - Chris Todd & Beth Evans, NHS England - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6012_Using_classification_modelling_to%20investigate_changes_in_%20HRG/index.html

4. (12:07) Predicting gestational diabetes using Machine Learning, assessing travel times to maternity units and simulating inpatient flow - Rochelle Francis-Reid, Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6023_predicting_gestational_diabetes_using_ML/index.html

HSMA Site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.title: Optimising Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) Resourcing with Simulation Modelling
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dr Hannah Thould (Chief Registratr, University Hospitals Bristol and Weston NHS Foundation Trust) about her project on optimising resourcing for same day emergency care using discrete event simulation (DES). Hannah also reflects on her experience of the HSMA programme as a clinician. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6060_optimising_resourcing/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Using Geographic Modelling to Redraw North West Ambulance Dispatch Boundaries
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dorota Scott, Dr Kristian Boote and Charlotte Anderson (North West Ambulance Service NHS Foundation Trust) about their project on redrawing the dispatch boundaries of the ambulance in their services using geographic modelling, including the use of Voronoi tessellations. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6056_Redrawing_NW_Ambulance_dispatch_boundaries/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Modelling Eye Injection Pathways with the AMD Protocol Explorer (APE)
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dr Luke Herbert (Consultant Opthalmic Surgeon, Surrey & Sussex Healthcare Foundation Trust) about his project on simulating opthalmology pathways, allowing the exploration of the impact of different anti-VEGF treatment strategies on patients and costs.

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6007_Modelling_eye_injection_pathways/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Using Natural Language Processing to Improve Ambulance Care Quality Indicator (ACQI) Data
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from James Wise and Phil King (South Central Ambulance Service NHS Foundation Trust) about their project on using natural language processing to improve ambulance care quality indicator (ACQI) data. By processing the data that is currently held in free text fields, they are aiming to improve the completion of the ACQI dataset, supporting the clinical audit process.

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6005_Improving_ambulance_care/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Modelling the Benefit of Making Every Contact Count (MECC) Training using Agent Based Simulation
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dom Rowney, Sam Vautier and Dr Luke Herbert about their project on using agent-based simulation to model behavioural dynamics and explore the potential impact of MECC training. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6040_benefit_of_MECC_using_ABS/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Forecasting A&E Attendance to Inform Staff Planning
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Yu Qiao (Clinical Data Scientist, Liverpool University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) about his project on forecasting future A&E attendances 6 weeks in advance, accounting for seasonal patterns and allowing better management of the staffing level to ensure the predicted demand can be met.

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6011_Forecasting_modelling_for_A&E_attendance/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

#nhs #datascience #operationalresearch

videos.title: Modelling Hyperacute/Acute Stroke Pathways - Reducing Costs & Improving Patient Care
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from John Williams (Clinical Data Scientist, Maidstone and Tunbridge Wells NHS Trust) about his project on using discrete event simulation to explore the impact of changes to operating hours of the same-day emergency care (SDEC) stroke pathway and the CT perfusion scanner in acute and hyperacute stroke pathways. This model allows the potential cost savings through admission avoidance and length of stay reductions to be explored. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6055_DES_modelling_Hyperacute_Acute_Stroke_Pathway/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.description:
In this session, we hear about four different projects undertaken by our HSMAs. 

1. (0:40) Acute Ward Bed Occupancy Simulation - Rey Tan, Royal United Hospitals Bath NHS Foundation Trust - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6013_Modelling_bed_occupancy_acute_ward/index.html

2. 3. (9:45) Segmenting Dorset's Population for Better Health Planning - Rhianna Everett, Dorset Intelligence & Insight Service; James Roberts, Dorset Council - https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6044_Population_segmentation_GP_registered_Dorset/index.html

4. (13:45) Understanding the Drivers of Length of Stay (LoS) - Jake Kealey, North Central London ICB -  https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6010_Understanding_drivers_of_increased_length_of_stay/index.html

videos.title: Creating a Simulation Model of a Mental Health Hub
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Nathan Hack and Dr Helen Wharam (Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust) about their project on building a simulation model of a mental health hub in Portsmouth to help with right-sizing the service as routes into the service are expanded.

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6026_Modelling_secondary_care_psychological_therapy_flow/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.title: Proactive Patient Attendance Prediction
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Peter Andrews (Information Business Partner, Barts Health NHS Trust) about his project on using machine learning to forecast non-attendance and help reduce the number of unattended appointments, potentially improving patient experience and saving money. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6046_Proactive_Patient_attendance_prediction/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.title: Developing a Primary Care Load Management Tool
videos.description:
In this talk, we hear from Dr Chris Lewis (General Practitioner, The Park Medical Practice) about his project on using modelling and data science techniques to better monitor and plan for the staffing of a GP surgery, helping patients to have their phone calls answered in a timely manner while avoiding over-resourcing. 

Project Page: https://hsma.co.uk/previous_projects/hsma_6/H6_6062_primary_care_load_management_tool/index.html
HSMA site: https://www.hsma.co.uk

videos.description:
In this talk, HSMA 5 Alumnus Peter Saiu talks us through his user-friendly, web-based tool for allocating additional GP funding equitably, helping to save commissioners time and reduce health inequalities.

videos.title: An Alumnus Story : Life Beyond HSMA
videos.description:
“An Alumnus Story : Life Beyond HSMA” Matt Eves, Derbyshire Community Health Services

In this talk, Matt Eves (HSMA alumnus) will talk about the work he has undertaken since being part of the HSMA programme in 2022, including work to develop automated tools with web application interfaces that transform analytical capabilities.

videos.title: Showcase 1 : Modelling "stuff" and "staff" in end of of life care during the COVID-19 pandemic
videos.description:
The first in our series of project showcases, in which we showcase some current and previous work of the PenCHORD research team (that run the HSMA Programme) to serve as inspiration for potential HSMA projects.

In this showcase, Dr Daniel Chalk talks about his 2020 work modelling the resourcing needs for providing end of life care during the COVID-19 pandemic.

You can access the Free and Open Source model being discussed here : https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1K0-xsqG_uIpoWhw86tjOUM55OcFfhq_2#scrollTo=w_pHUWHADoXY

You can read the paper published in BMJ Open here : https://bmjopen.bmj.com/content/bmjopen/11/5/e043795.full.pdf

More information about the HSMA Programme can be found here : https://sites.google.com/nihr.ac.uk/hsma

Follow us on Twitter : @PenCHORD_UoE @drdanielchalk

videos.title: Showcase 2 : A Simulation Modelling Toolkit for Organising Dialysis Services During a Pandemic
videos.description:
The second in our series of project showcases, in which we showcase some current and previous work of the PenCHORD research team (that run the HSMA Programme) to serve as inspiration for potential HSMA projects.

In this showcase, Prof Tom Monks talks about his 2020 work modelling the safe transportation and operational delivery of services for dialysis patients in Wessex at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic.

Paper about the work : https://bit.ly/covid-sim-dialysis
Open Source code for the work : https://bit.ly/dialysis-code
General paper about simulation modelling to support the pandemic response : https://bit.ly/covid-simulation

More information about the HSMA Programme can be found here : https://sites.google.com/nihr.ac.uk/hsma

Follow us on Twitter : @PenCHORD_UoE

videos.title: Showcase 3 : Factors influencing Clinically Ready to Proceed Times within an ED Setting
videos.description:
The third in our series of project showcases, in which we showcase some current and previous work of the PenCHORD research team (that run the HSMA Programme) to serve as inspiration for potential HSMA projects.

In this showcase, Elliott talks about his 2022 work using Machine Learning methods to try to better understand the factors that influence longer times to "clinically ready to proceed" decisions being made in an Emergency Department in Cornwall, UK.

More information about the HSMA Programme can be found here : https://sites.google.com/nihr.ac.uk/hsma

Follow us on Twitter : @PenCHORD_UoE

videos.title: Showcase 4 : Using Discrete Event Simulation to identify the delays in a bladder cancer pathway
videos.description:
The fourth in our series of project showcases, in which we showcase some current and previous work of the PenCHORD research team (that run the HSMA Programme) to serve as inspiration for potential HSMA projects.

In this showcase, Dan talks about his 2016 work using Discrete Event Simulation to model the delays from referral to treatment for muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients in Cornwall, and how the model was used to lead to significant improvements in waiting times for these patients.

More information about the HSMA Programme can be found here : https://sites.google.com/nihr.ac.uk/hsma

Follow us on Twitter : @PenCHORD_UoE

videos.title: Showcase 5 : Geographic modelling and optimisation of locations of emergency stroke units
videos.description:
The fifth in our series of project showcases, in which we showcase some current and previous work of the PenCHORD research team (that run the HSMA Programme) to serve as inspiration for potential HSMA projects.

In this showcase, Mike talks about work looking at using genetic algorithms to try to optimise the location of national stroke units given competing priorities.

More information about the HSMA Programme can be found here : https://sites.google.com/nihr.ac.uk/hsma

Follow us on Twitter : @PenCHORD_UoE
